limitations: Not a before/after FPS benchmark or a device-farm test.
Worker count is a conservative device-resource policy, not a measured optimum.
Job byte arrays still use bounded JSON; not zero-copy.
Inline and Worker have next-tick barriers; late computation can stall simulation.
Kernel costs include isolated VM creation and compilation.
Presentation interpolation and buffer recycling have focused tests; no new 10000-unit performance claim.
Binary manifests identify pre-commit dirty builds; hashes identify the artifacts tested.
